name: Image variations
summary: POST /v1/images/variations with `model: dall-e-2` — generate variations of an existing image. DALL·E 2 only.
description: Separate from image generation and image edits, `POST /v1/images/variations` takes an input image and produces variations. `model` is a top-level required param, but only `dall-e-2` is supported. Tracked separately from `image-generation-direct` because it exercises a distinct code path (image-in, image-out with no prompt) and because DALL·E 2 is the sole supported upstream, which makes BYOM routing narrower than for generations.
notes: Status-only. Included as a distinct card because it appears in the OpenAI docs as its own endpoint with a `model` field, even though the practical BYOM surface is narrow.
